messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Done: I fixed both problems in the Mac app, and it builds cleanly with `./build.sh`. I haven't watched it running yet; it starts using the changes when Jarvis restarts it. - **Middle-screen pop-ups:** the "Claude Code / Codex / Grok is done" box used to appear whenever Jarvis's own quick replies or builders were busy on the Mac. Now it only appears when one of your own Claude Code or Codex sessions finishes. It also no longer covers up a question box that has answer buttons. - **Chat delay:** new messages used to come out one at a time, 2.5 seconds apart.

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: That held back the chat, the phone and replies to your messages, and could leave an older line marked as the newest. Now everything updates right away and in order, and only a second speech bubble from the same speaker waits 2.5 seconds. - **"On it" order:** the "On it. This one's taking a minute." line can no longer land after the finished reply. I didn't change the iPhone app because I found no cause there; its chat checks the Mac every 3 seconds.

messages.name: Claude Code

messages.text: Done: I made the iPhone app keep trying until a message gets through, and added a "landed" sign on both devices. Both apps build and the new phone build is installed on the connected iPhone ("Preston"), but I haven't seen a phone message reach Jarvis yet. That only works once Jarvis restarts the Mac app. - **iPhone:** every message, reply button, notification reply and Siri message is saved before it's sent. It keeps retrying until the Mac confirms it, so nothing is lost to a bad signal or a closed app.

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Under the message it shows "Sending…", "No connection · will keep trying", "Sent · waiting for your Mac" or "Landed ✓". If one gives up, it shows "Didn't send · tap to try again". - **Mac:** a phone message shows a green banner on the strip for 30 seconds ("📱 ✓ Landed from your phone"), and the menu bar shows "J 📱✓" for 10 minutes. Messages sent while the Mac was asleep or offline are picked up when it reconnects, as long as it's within 12 hours.

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: A message that gets sent twice is only posted once. Messages from the phone still go to the team chat, where Jarvis reads them. Once Jarvis has restarted the Mac app, James should send one message from his phone on mobile data (Wi-Fi off) and check for the green banner on the Mac and "Landed ✓" on the phone.
